title: Regal Studio Presents: To My Younger Self
original_title: Regal Studio Presents: Para Sa Batang Ako
overview: Because of repeated rejections from publishers, Erika (Shuvee Etrata) is about to give up on her dream of publishing a book. At her lowest moment of doubt, Eka (Aaliyah Marie Cortes), a mysterious child, arrives and tries to restore her inspiration and hope. Will she finish the book and believe in her own abilities again?
